And English formatting: `en` alone gives US style ("December 10, 2026", "€11.15"). | Marketing + Product | We write `en`, other catalogs translated before launch. `en` formats as `en-150` ("10 December 2026"). |
88	
89	## P3: low
90	
91	| ID | Question | Owner | Working assumption |
92	|---|---|---|---|
93	| Q26 | `currency` returned by the mock but not in the API notes. | Backend | Field exists; always `EUR`. |
94	| Q27 | Promo codes and gift subscriptions coming later; order body is `planId` only. `_m` suffix hints at annual plans. | Product + Backend | Order payload built by one function so fields can be added. No promo UI. |
95	| Q28 | The mock uses the `{error}` format on plans, `/v1/me` and CMS too, not only identity. | Backend | Covered by the adapter in Q18. |
96	| Q29 | Mock `api_500` doesn't affect `GET /v1/plans`, which implies plans are fetched at build. | Backend | See Q23. |
97	# 04 · User flow and state machine
98	
99	Behaviour of the subscribe flow, from plan list to confirmed. Q-numbers refer to `03-open-questions.md`.
100	
101	## Terms
102	
103	- **Open order**: the last order this browser created, kept in storage that every tab shares and that outlives the tab (Q37). It holds orderId, `paymentUrl`, plan and market. It is cleared when the server reports `paid`, `failed` or 404.
104	- **Attempt marker**: written to shared storage just before `POST /v1/orders` and removed once the response arrives (Q39).
105	- **Retry point**: the place where failures land and where an explicit "Pay" or "Try again" lives. That's Review when `reviewStep` is on. When it's off, it's Plans with the chosen plan preselected and a banner (Q38).
106	- **Gate**: the check that every path into CreatingOrder passes first (see below).
107	
108	## Invariants
109	
110	1. **One order per attempt.** Only an explicit click at the retry point creates an order. Reload, Back, return, polling and a second tab never create one. While an open order is `pending` or `requires_action`, no new order is created in any tab: it's resumed instead (Q30, Q37).
111	2. **Trust: server > stored context > URL query.** Order status and identity come only from the API. Stored context beats the URL for plan, market and locale. The URL is used only when nothing is stored (Q7). `cancelled=1` is a hint that the server must confirm.
112	3. **Polling errors never show "payment failed".** Only `status: failed` from `GET /v1/orders/{id}` means failed. Network errors, 5xx, 401 and 404 have their own states.
113	4. **Every state has an exit.** Each non-terminal state has at least one action the user can take or a timeout. No state has only a spinner.
114	5. **Context survives redirects.** Plan, market, locale, `utm_*` (and orderId after payment) are in every `returnUrl` (Q7).
115	6. **State is re-derived on every show.** Each state runs its "on enter" step on first load, on reload and when Back restores the page from the back-forward cache. Disabled buttons are re-enabled when the page is restored. Nothing on the page is trusted until on-enter has run again.
116	
117	## Happy path
118	
119	```
120	Entry ─/v1/me─▶ Plans ─select─▶ StartingEid ─▶ [eID] ─▶ EidCallback ─/v1/me─▶ Review
121	  ─Pay─▶ Gate ─▶ CreatingOrder ─▶ [payment] ─▶ PaymentReturn ─▶ Polling ─paid─▶ Confirmed
122	```
123	
124	Shortcuts:
125	- An identified user (Entry `/v1/me` 200) skips eID. Select → Review, or Gate if `reviewStep` is off.
126	- With `reviewStep` off, the flow skips Review: Verifying → Gate (Q32).
127	
128	## Gate (before every order)
129	
130	1. **Open order present** → `GET /v1/orders/{id}`.
131	   - `pending` or `requires_action` → **Resume**: no new order.
132	   - `paid` → Confirmed.
133	   - `failed` or 404 → clear it, continue.
134	   - 401 → IdentityLost.
135	   - 5xx or network → retry point + error. Pay disabled until the check succeeds.
136	2. **Attempt marker present** (a reload or crash during CreatingOrder) → clear it and show "Your last attempt didn't finish" at the retry point. Pay needs one more click. The lost order never got a `paymentUrl`, so it can't be paid (Q39).
137	3. **`GET /v1/me`** → `activeSubscription` → Account. 401 → StartingEid (context kept). 5xx or network → retry point + error, no order. 200 → CreatingOrder.
138	
139	**Resume** = the retry point shows only "Continue payment" (reuses `paymentUrl`) and "Check status" (→ PaymentReturn). Pay and "Change plan" are hidden.
140	
141	## States
142	
143	| State | On enter | Exits |
144	|---|---|---|
145	| **Entry** | `GET /v1/me` | 200 + `activeSubscription` → **Account**. 200 → Plans (identified). 401 → Plans (anonymous). 5xx/network → Plans (anonymous, checked again after eID) |
146	| **Plans** | Show API plans for the market, matched to CMS cards (Q8). Market off by flag → root. Open order `pending` → Resume banner | Select: identified → Review (or Gate if `reviewStep` off). Anonymous → StartingEid |
147	| **StartingEid** | `POST /v1/identity/sessions` with returnUrl + context. Button disabled | 201 → redirect to `redirectUrl`. 429 → **RateLimited**. 400, 5xx or network → **StartError** |
148	| **RateLimited** | Countdown from `Retry-After` (fallback 30 s, Q35). Polite `aria-live` | Countdown ends → "Try again" enabled → StartingEid. "Change plan" → Plans (shows Resume if there's an open order) |
149	| **StartError** | "Can't start eID right now" | "Try again" → StartingEid. "Change plan" → Plans |
150	| **EidCallback** | Read `status` from the query. Every exit uses `history.replace`, so the callback URL never stays in history: Back or reload can't re-run it or re-send `identity_completed` (07) | `ok` → Verifying. `cancelled` → **EidFailed(cancelled)**. `expired`, missing or unknown → **EidFailed(expired)** (Q36) |
151	| **EidFailed** | Message for the reason | "Try again" → StartingEid (same context). "Change plan" → Plans |
152	| **Verifying** | `GET /v1/me` | 401 → **OtherBrowser**. 5xx/network → **VerifyError**. 200 + orderId in context (from IdentityLost) → **PaymentReturn** for that order, checked before the subscription. 200 + `activeSubscription` → **Account**. 200 → Review (or Gate if `reviewStep` off) |
153	| **VerifyError** | "We couldn't confirm your identity" | "Try again" → Verifying. "Start again" → StartingEid |
154	| **OtherBrowser** | "Continue in the browser where you started" (Q7) | "Start again here" → StartingEid using the context from the URL |
155	| **Review** | Fetch `GET /v1/plans` again (the price shown here is binding, Q23). Run Gate step 1 for display: an open `pending` order → Resume | Plan missing from API → Plans + notice. Plans fetch fails → error + retry, Pay disabled. "Pay" (disabled on click) → Gate. "Change plan" → Plans |
156	| **CreatingOrder** | Write the attempt marker. `POST /v1/orders` `{planId, market, returnUrl}` | 201 → save the open order, clear the marker → redirect to `paymentUrl`. 401 → StartingEid (context kept, Q17). 409 `already_subscribed` → **Account** (Q10). Other 409 → Gate once more (Q41). 400 `invalid_plan` → Plans + notice. 5xx → retry point + error. Network/no response → retry point + error, marker kept, no automatic retry (Q34) |
157	| **PaymentReturn** | orderId from stored context, else from the URL. None → Plans | One `GET /v1/orders/{id}`: `failed` + `cancelled=1` → **PaymentFailed(cancelled)**. `failed` → **PaymentFailed(declined)**. `paid` → Confirmed. Anything else → Polling |
158	| **Polling** | `GET /v1/orders/{id}` every 2 s for 20 s, then every 5 s, stop at 3 min (Q9). Status in a polite `aria-live` region | `paid` → Confirmed. `failed` → PaymentFailed(declined). `requires_action` → redirect to `actionUrl` (once per poll cycle). `pending` → keep polling. 20 s → "Still confirming" text. 3 min → **Unconfirmed**. 5xx/network → keep polling, show "Connection issue, still checking". 401 → **IdentityLost**. 404 → **OrderNotFound** |
159	| **PaymentFailed** | Open order cleared. Retry point + banner: cancelled ("Payment cancelled") or declined ("Payment was declined") (Q31) | "Try again" → Gate (**new order**). "Change plan" → Plans |
160	| **Unconfirmed** | "We'll confirm shortly", order id shown. Open order kept | "Check again" → one GET, then the same exits as Polling. "Go to account" → Account. No new order offered |
161	| **IdentityLost** | "Verify to see your payment status", order id shown. Open order kept (Q33) | "Verify" → StartingEid, returnUrl carries the orderId → Verifying → PaymentReturn |
162	| **OrderNotFound** | "We can't find this order", order id shown. Open order cleared | "Back to plans" → Plans. "Go to account" → Account |
163	| **Confirmed** | Order id, plan, trial note if any. `purchase` fires once per orderId (Q20), params taken from the open order before it's cleared (07). Then open order and context cleared. On reload the open order is gone: no trial note | Terminal. "Go to account" → Account. Reload → GET again; `paid` stays Confirmed |
164	| **Account** | Redirect to `ACCOUNT_URL` (Q10) | Terminal (outside the flow) |
165	
166	Trial shown on Review and Confirmed only if `trialEligible` and the plan is Standard or Premium (Q12).
167	
168	## Mock scenarios → path
169	
170	| Scenario | Path | Ends in |
171	|---|---|---|
172	| `happy` | Full happy path. Polling sees `paid` within ~3 s | Confirmed |
173	| `identity_cancelled` | StartingEid → eID → `?status=cancelled` | EidFailed(cancelled) → retry |
174	| `identity_slow` | Same as happy. The 8 s wait happens on the provider page, where we have no state | Confirmed |
175	| `rate_limited` | StartingEid → 429, `Retry-After: 30` | RateLimited → retry after countdown |
176	| `already_subscribed` | Anonymous: Verifying sees `activeSubscription`. Identified: Entry sees it. Gate step 3 and the order 409 also catch it | Account |
177	| `not_trial_eligible` | Happy path. Review shows the full price, no trial | Confirmed |
178	| `payment_declined` | PaymentReturn → `pending` → Polling → `failed` after ~1 s | PaymentFailed(declined) → new order on retry |
179	| `payment_slow` | Polling passes 20 s ("Still confirming") and sees `paid` at ~45 s | Confirmed |
180	| `payment_requires_action` | The mock sends the user to the challenge on its own, then returns. If polling sees `requires_action` (the user left the challenge), redirect to `actionUrl`. Approve → `paid`. Decline → `failed` | Confirmed / PaymentFailed(declined) |
181	| `api_500` | Plans render from the build. Entry `/v1/me` 500 → anonymous. StartingEid 500 → StartError. If already past eID: Verifying → VerifyError, Gate → retry point + error, polling → "Connection issue" → Unconfirmed after 3 min | StartError / VerifyError / Unconfirmed, never PaymentFailed |
182	
183	Cases not tied to a scenario:
184	
185	| Case | Trigger in mock | Ends in |
186	|---|---|---|
187	| eID expired | Wait > 5 min on the eID page, or reuse a completed session | EidFailed(expired) |
188	| Payment cancelled | "Cancel" on the pay page → `&cancelled=1`, order `failed` | PaymentFailed(cancelled) |
189	| Back from payment page | Browser Back to Review (fresh load or restored from the back-forward cache), order `pending` | Invariant 6 → Resume (same order) |
190	| Double tap on Pay | Two clicks | One request (in-flight guard in the handler; button `aria-disabled`, 08) |
191	| Reload during CreatingOrder | F5 before the 201 | Gate step 2 → "last attempt didn't finish". No payable duplicate |
192	| Second tab while paying | Tab A on the payment page or polling, tab B opens Plans/Review | Tab B shows Resume. No second order |
193	| Session expired on the payment page | Pay → return → poll 401 | IdentityLost → eID → PaymentReturn (mock: 404 → OrderNotFound, because every mock eID creates a new customer) |
194	| Session expired then rate-limited | IdentityLost → Verify → 429 → "Change plan" | Plans with Resume. No new order while the first is `pending` |
195	| Return in another browser | Open the callback URL without the cookie | OtherBrowser / IdentityLost |
196	| Session expired mid-flow (1 h) | Gate `/v1/me` or order POST → 401 | StartingEid (context kept) |
197	| Reload on Confirmed | F5 | Confirmed, `purchase` not sent again |
198	| Foreign or stale orderId | Poll → 404 | OrderNotFound |
199	# 07 · Analytics
200	
201	The GA4 events the flow sends through GTM, what they carry, and when they may be sent. Transitions refer to `04-user-flow-state-machine.md`. Q-numbers refer to `03-open-questions.md`. Quality checks are in `08-quality.md`.
202	
203	Marks: **[D]** in `docs/04-analytics-notes.md` · **[A]** our rule.
204	
205	Out of the thin slice (PLAN.md). Server-side `purchase` and extra events are cut (PLAN.md cut list).
206	
207	## What the docs give us, and what they don't
208	
209	- Six events, names fixed by marketing ("keep names exactly as written") [D]. Happy path only: no event for a cancel, decline, error or timeout.
210	- Only `purchase` has params: `transaction_id`, `value`, `currency` [D]. Nothing for the other five (Q20).
211	- "UTM parameters should survive until `purchase`" [D]. No storage rule, and the flow leaves our origin once or twice: eID, then payment (plus `actionUrl` on `requires_action`). Return can land in another browser (Q7).
212	- No consent mechanism (Q5). GA4 in the EU needs prior consent for analytics cookies.
213	- `purchase` fired in the browser misses every user who never comes back from payment, and can fire twice (reload, second tab, second browser).
214	- The order API returns no amount, currency or trial flag (Q4). `value` is our estimate.
215	
216	## Module
217	
218	One pure module, `analytics.ts`:
219	
220	- `track(event, params)`: typed map of the six events → their params. Unknown event = type error.
221	- Adds the common params, checks consent, applies the once-rules, then `dataLayer.push`.
222	- Components and state handlers call `track` on the transitions below. Nothing else touches `dataLayer`.
223	- Unit-tested: params per event, once-rules, consent gate, no personal data.
224	
225	## Events
226	
227	Each event is bound to one transition in 04. Not firing elsewhere is part of the rule.
228	
229	| Event [D] | Fires on (04) | Params (plus common) | Once-rule [A] |
230	|---|---|---|---|
231	| `plan_viewed` | **Entry → Plans** (after `/v1/me` resolves: 200 identified, 401 or 5xx anonymous). Not on Change plan, retry point (reviewStep off), invalid_plan notice, or Entry → Account | `identified` (bool) | Once per document load of Plans via Entry. Reload = new view (GA semantics). bfcache restore (`pageshow.persisted`) re-runs Entry (04 invariant 6) but does not fire |
232	| `plan_selected` | **Plans —select→** (any target: StartingEid, Review, Gate) | `plan_id` | Every select. Change plan → select again fires again |
233	| `identity_started` | **StartingEid —201→ redirect to `redirectUrl`**. Not on click (may 429/fail) | `plan_id`, `eid_purpose`: `checkout` \| `reverify` (reverify = orderId in context, from IdentityLost) | Once per 201. Retry after EidFailed/RateLimited fires again: each is a real start |
234	| `identity_completed` | **Verifying —200→** (any target: Review, Gate, Account, PaymentReturn). Not on `?status=ok` alone: only `/v1/me` proves it | `plan_id`, `eid_purpose` | Once per callback load. EidCallback exits use `history.replace` (04), so Back or reload never re-enters it. Not fired when Entry `/v1/me` 200 skips eID |
235	| `payment_started` | **CreatingOrder —201→ redirect to `paymentUrl`**. Not on Resume "Continue payment", not on `actionUrl` redirect | `plan_id`, `transaction_id` (= `orderId`) | Once per orderId (one 201 per order) |
236	| `purchase` | **Enter Confirmed**. 04 has several edges in (PaymentReturn, Polling, Gate step 1, Unconfirmed "Check again"); all mean the same server fact `paid`, so the binding is to the state, not an edge | `transaction_id`, `value`, `currency` [D]; `plan_id`, `trial`, `tax` [A] | Once per orderId per browser. Guard key in `localStorage` (shared by tabs, outlives the tab), not `sessionStorage` (Q20). Reload on Confirmed = no event |
237	
238	Redirect events (`identity_started`, `payment_started`): push with GTM `eventCallback`, navigate on callback but not before 300 ms (time for the "Opening …" announcement, 08) and not after 500 ms. Otherwise the hit can be lost to the navigation. Blocked GTM never blocks the redirect.
239	
240	### `purchase` params
241	
242	| Param | Value | Source |
243	|---|---|---|
244	| `transaction_id` | `orderId` | `POST /v1/orders` [D] |
245	| `value` | Gross price the user saw (incl. VAT), in euros, 2 decimals. `0` if trial applied (Q4) | Snapshot taken at CreatingOrder into the open order: Review price, or plan card price when `reviewStep` off. Same formula as 05 (Q2) |
246	| `tax` | VAT part of `value` (`0` on trial). Lets marketing derive net per market (Q46) | Same snapshot |
247	| `currency` | `currency` from `/v1/plans` (always `EUR`, Q26) | Snapshot |
248	| `trial` | `true` \| `false` \| `unknown` | Snapshot of "trial shown" (Q12). After payment `trialEligible` may flip, so never re-read `/v1/me` for this |
249	| `plan_id` | API plan id | Snapshot, else `GET /v1/orders/{id}.planId` |
250	
251	No snapshot (return in another browser, Q7, Q33): `value` from `/v1/plans` for `planId` + market, `trial: unknown`. Marketing must treat these as estimates.
252	
253	Why the snapshot: the server returns no amount (Q4), and the price is binding only on Review (Q23).
254	
255	Order on Confirmed (04): build `purchase` params from the snapshot, call `track`, then clear the open order. `track` resolves all params at call time, so a queued event (before consent) doesn't depend on storage cleared later.
256	
257	## Common params (every event)
258	
259	| Param | Value | Notes |
260	|---|---|---|
261	| `market` | `EE` \| `LV` \| `LT` | Uppercase, as the API. From flow context (stored > `returnUrl` query > path, 04 invariant 2); callbacks have no market in the path |
262	| `locale` | `et` \| `lv` \| `lt` \| `en` | Same source as `market` |
263	| `review_step` | `true` \| `false` | Build flag value. Needed to compare funnels when the flag flips (Q3, Q32) |
264	| `utm_source`, `utm_medium`, `utm_campaign`, `utm_term`, `utm_content` | As captured, omitted when absent | See below. Truncated to 100 chars (GA4 param limit) |
265	
266	Marketing registers the custom params (`plan_id`, `market`, `locale`, `review_step`, `trial`, `eid_purpose`, `identified`) as GA4 custom dimensions. Without that they aren't reportable.
267	
268	### No personal data
269	
270	Never sent: `customerId`, eID data (none is exposed anyway, Q15), `sessionId`, `paymentUrl`, `actionUrl`, `redirectUrl`, `returnUrl`, error messages. `orderId` is pseudonymous and required by marketing as `transaction_id`. A unit test asserts the param whitelist per event.
271	
272	## UTM capture and storage
273	
274	**Capture** [A]: on Entry, read `utm_*` from the landing URL. A new landing with any `utm_*` replaces the whole set (last campaign wins). A landing without UTMs keeps a stored set. Other query params are ignored (`gclid` etc.).
275	
276	**Carry**: two (three with `actionUrl`) cross-origin redirects, maybe into another browser (Q7).
277	
278	| Where | Before consent | After consent |
279	|---|---|---|
280	| Memory (current page, client-side navigation) | yes | yes |
281	| `returnUrl` query, eID and payment (Q7) | yes: URL, not storage (Q5) | yes |
282	| `sessionStorage` (same tab, after a redirect) | no | yes |
283	
284	Trust order as 04 invariant 2: stored > `returnUrl` query. On return, the app reads UTMs from the query only when nothing is stored. Without consent, UTMs exist only in the URL, so they survive the redirects but not a manual reload of a page without them.
285	
286	`returnUrl` keeps the standard `utm_*` names. Side effect: the return page view re-states the campaign, so GA4 doesn't credit the eID or payment provider as a referral. Still needed from marketing: eID and payment domains in GA4 "unwanted referrals" (Q47).
287	
288	Limits: UTMs add to `returnUrl` length, and the provider/API limit is not documented (02). UTMs reach the eID and payment providers in the URL; they hold no personal data.
289	
290	## Consent
291	
292	Assumption Q5: GTM Consent Mode v2, basic mode (no Google tags before consent). CMP vendor unknown.
293	
294	| | Before a decision | Granted (`analytics_storage`) | Denied or withdrawn |
295	|---|---|---|---|
296	| Consent default | `gtag('consent', 'default', {analytics_storage, ad_storage, ad_user_data, ad_personalization: 'denied'})` before GTM loads | `update` by the CMP | stays denied |
297	| App events | Queued in memory, current page only | Queue flushed, then pushed live | Queue dropped, nothing pushed |
298	| UTMs | Memory + URL | + `sessionStorage` | Memory + URL. Withdrawal clears our keys |
299	| `purchase` guard | not written | `localStorage` | not written. Withdrawal keeps existing keys (orderId only, no personal data), so a re-grant + reload can't send `purchase` twice |
300	| GA cookies (`_ga`) | none | set by GA | none |
301	
302	- Queued events not flushed before a redirect or reload are lost. Accepted (Q5): a user who decides after eID shows `identity_completed` without `plan_viewed`/`plan_selected`/`identity_started`, so the top of the funnel is undercounted.
303	- Return in another browser: no CMP cookie there, so the banner shows again on the callback page; events queue until the decision.
304	- The flow never waits for, or depends on, consent or GTM. Functional storage (open order, attempt marker, Q37) is not analytics and needs no consent.
305	- Advanced mode (cookieless pings) is a Legal decision (Q5).
306	- The CMP and GTM count against LCP, INP and CLS on Plans, not the JS size budget (08).
307	
308	## Known gaps of client-side events
309	
310	| Gap | Effect | Fix |
311	|---|---|---|
312	| User never returns from payment (closes tab, Unconfirmed → "Go to account", provider return fails) | `purchase` never sent, revenue undercounted | Server-side `purchase` (cut, PLAN.md) |
313	| Return in another tab or browser | Guard is per browser: a second browser can send `purchase` again. GA4 drops a repeated `transaction_id` only for the same user | Server-side `purchase` (cut) |
314	| Return in another browser | New GA client id: `purchase` attributed to a new user, campaign only from `returnUrl` UTMs | Server-side `purchase` (cut) |
315	| Consent denied | No events at all | Accepted (Legal) |
316	| Ad/tracking blockers | No events | Server-side `purchase` (cut) |
317	| `value` is an estimate | Can differ from what was charged | Amount on the order (Q4) |

# A. Product brief: "Subscribe in three steps"

**Goal.** Raise web conversion from visitor to paid subscriber by 15% by the end of Q1.

**Flow.** Choose a plan, identify with eID, pay, done. The whole thing should take under two minutes. Seventy percent of our web traffic is on phones.

**Plans.** Basic, Standard and Premium. New customers get a 30-day free trial on Standard and Premium.

**Pricing.** Show consumer prices including VAT, per month, in euros.

**Content.** Marketing must be able to change plan page copy, badges and the FAQ without an engineer.

**Later.** We will probably add promo codes and gift subscriptions, so please do not make those hard to add.

# 04 · User flow and state machine

Behaviour of the subscribe flow, from plan list to confirmed. Q-numbers refer to `03-open-questions.md`.

## Terms

- **Open order**: the last order this browser created, kept in storage that every tab shares and that outlives the tab (Q37). It holds orderId, `paymentUrl`, plan and market. It is cleared when the server reports `paid`, `failed` or 404.
- **Attempt marker**: written to shared storage just before `POST /v1/orders` and removed once the response arrives (Q39).
- **Retry point**: the place where failures land and where an explicit "Pay" or "Try again" lives. That's Review when `reviewStep` is on. When it's off, it's Plans with the chosen plan preselected and a banner (Q38).
- **Gate**: the check that every path into CreatingOrder passes first (see below).

## Invariants

1. **One order per attempt.** Only an explicit click at the retry point creates an order. Reload, Back, return, polling and a second tab never create one. While an open order is `pending` or `requires_action`, no new order is created in any tab: it's resumed instead (Q30, Q37).
2. **Trust: server > stored context > URL query.** Order status and identity come only from the API. Stored context beats the URL for plan, market and locale. The URL is used only when nothing is stored (Q7). `cancelled=1` is a hint that the server must confirm.
3. **Polling errors never show "payment failed".** Only `status: failed` from `GET /v1/orders/{id}` means failed. Network errors, 5xx, 401 and 404 have their own states.
4. **Every state has an exit.** Each non-terminal state has at least one action the user can take or a timeout. No state has only a spinner.
5. **Context survives redirects.** Plan, market, locale, `utm_*` (and orderId after payment) are in every `returnUrl` (Q7).
6. **State is re-derived on every show.** Each state runs its "on enter" step on first load, on reload and when Back restores the page from the back-forward cache. Disabled buttons are re-enabled when the page is restored. Nothing on the page is trusted until on-enter has run again.

## Happy path

```
Entry ─/v1/me─▶ Plans ─select─▶ StartingEid ─▶ [eID] ─▶ EidCallback ─/v1/me─▶ Review
  ─Pay─▶ Gate ─▶ CreatingOrder ─▶ [payment] ─▶ PaymentReturn ─▶ Polling ─paid─▶ Confirmed
```

Shortcuts:
- An identified user (Entry `/v1/me` 200) skips eID. Select → Review, or Gate if `reviewStep` is off.
- With `reviewStep` off, the flow skips Review: Verifying → Gate (Q32).

## Gate (before every order)

1. **Open order present** → `GET /v1/orders/{id}`.
   - `pending` or `requires_action` → **Resume**: no new order.
   - `paid` → Confirmed.
   - `failed` or 404 → clear it, continue.
   - 401 → IdentityLost.
   - 5xx or network → retry point + error. Pay disabled until the check succeeds.
2. **Attempt marker present** (a reload or crash during CreatingOrder) → clear it and show "Your last attempt didn't finish" at the retry point. Pay needs one more click. The lost order never got a `paymentUrl`, so it can't be paid (Q39).
3. **`GET /v1/me`** → `activeSubscription` → Account. 401 → StartingEid (context kept). 5xx or network → retry point + error, no order. 200 → CreatingOrder.

**Resume** = the retry point shows only "Continue payment" (reuses `paymentUrl`) and "Check status" (→ PaymentReturn). Pay and "Change plan" are hidden.

# 07 · Analytics

The GA4 events the flow sends through GTM, what they carry, and when they may be sent. Transitions refer to `04-user-flow-state-machine.md`. Q-numbers refer to `03-open-questions.md`. Quality checks are in `08-quality.md`.

Marks: **[D]** in `docs/04-analytics-notes.md` · **[A]** our rule.

Out of the thin slice (PLAN.md). Server-side `purchase` and extra events are cut (PLAN.md cut list).

## What the docs give us, and what they don't

- Six events, names fixed by marketing ("keep names exactly as written") [D]. Happy path only: no event for a cancel, decline, error or timeout.
- Only `purchase` has params: `transaction_id`, `value`, `currency` [D]. Nothing for the other five (Q20).
- "UTM parameters should survive until `purchase`" [D]. No storage rule, and the flow leaves our origin once or twice: eID, then payment (plus `actionUrl` on `requires_action`). Return can land in another browser (Q7).
- No consent mechanism (Q5). GA4 in the EU needs prior consent for analytics cookies.
- `purchase` fired in the browser misses every user who never comes back from payment, and can fire twice (reload, second tab, second browser).
- The order API returns no amount, currency or trial flag (Q4). `value` is our estimate.

## Module

One pure module, `analytics.ts`:

- `track(event, params)`: typed map of the six events → their params. Unknown event = type error.
- Adds the common params, checks consent, applies the once-rules, then `dataLayer.push`.
- Components and state handlers call `track` on the transitions below. Nothing else touches `dataLayer`.
- Unit-tested: params per event, once-rules, consent gate, no personal data.

Each event is bound to one transition in 04. Not firing elsewhere is part of the rule.

Not on Change plan, retry point (reviewStep off), invalid_plan notice, or Entry → Account | `identified` (bool) | Once per document load of Plans via Entry. Reload = new view (GA semantics). bfcache restore (`pageshow.persisted`) re-runs Entry (04 invariant 6) but does not fire |

Not on `?status=ok` alone: only `/v1/me` proves it | `plan_id`, `eid_purpose` | Once per callback load. EidCallback exits use `history.replace` (04), so Back or reload never re-enters it. | `payment_started` | **CreatingOrder —201→ redirect to `paymentUrl`**. Not on Resume "Continue payment", not on `actionUrl` redirect | `plan_id`, `transaction_id` (= `orderId`) | Once per orderId (one 201 per order) |
| `purchase` | **Enter Confirmed**. 04 has several edges in (PaymentReturn, Polling, Gate step 1, Unconfirmed "Check again"); all mean the same server fact `paid`, so the binding is to the state, not an edge | `transaction_id`, `value`, `currency` [D]; `plan_id`, `trial`, `tax` [A] | Once per orderId per browser. Guard key in `localStorage` (shared by tabs, outlives the tab), not `sessionStorage` (Q20). Reload on Confirmed = no event |

Redirect events (`identity_started`, `payment_started`): push with GTM `eventCallback`, navigate on callback but not before 300 ms (time for the "Opening …" announcement, 08) and not after 500 ms. Otherwise the hit can be lost to the navigation. Blocked GTM never blocks the redirect.

### `purchase` params

| Param | Value | Source |
|---|---|---|
| `transaction_id` | `orderId` | `POST /v1/orders` [D] |
| `value` | Gross price the user saw (incl. VAT), in euros, 2 decimals. `0` if trial applied (Q4) | Snapshot taken at CreatingOrder into the open order: Review price, or plan card price when `reviewStep` off. Same formula as 05 (Q2) |
| `tax` | VAT part of `value` (`0` on trial). Lets marketing derive net per market (Q46) | Same snapshot |
| `currency` | `currency` from `/v1/plans` (always `EUR`, Q26) | Snapshot |
| `trial` | `true` \| `false` \| `unknown` | Snapshot of "trial shown" (Q12). After payment `trialEligible` may flip, so never re-read `/v1/me` for this |
| `plan_id` | API plan id | Snapshot, else `GET /v1/orders/{id}.planId` |

No snapshot (return in another browser, Q7, Q33): `value` from `/v1/plans` for `planId` + market, `trial: unknown`. Marketing must treat these as estimates.

Why the snapshot: the server returns no amount (Q4), and the price is binding only on Review (Q23).

Order on Confirmed (04): build `purchase` params from the snapshot, call `track`, then clear the open order. `track` resolves all params at call time, so a queued event (before consent) doesn't depend on storage cleared later.

## Common params (every event)

| Param | Value | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `market` | `EE` \| `LV` \| `LT` | Uppercase, as the API. From flow context (stored > `returnUrl` query > path, 04 invariant 2); callbacks have no market in the path |
| `locale` | `et` \| `lv` \| `lt` \| `en` | Same source as `market` |
| `review_step` | `true` \| `false` | Build flag value. Needed to compare funnels when the flag flips (Q3, Q32) |
| `utm_source`, `utm_medium`, `utm_campaign`, `utm_term`, `utm_content` | As captured, omitted when absent | See below. Truncated to 100 chars (GA4 param limit) |

Marketing registers the custom params (`plan_id`, `market`, `locale`, `review_step`, `trial`, `eid_purpose`, `identified`) as GA4 custom dimensions. Without that they aren't reportable.

### No personal data

Never sent: `customerId`, eID data (none is exposed anyway, Q15), `sessionId`, `paymentUrl`, `actionUrl`, `redirectUrl`, `returnUrl`, error messages. `orderId` is pseudonymous and required by marketing as `transaction_id`. A unit test asserts the param whitelist per event.

## UTM capture and storage

**Capture** [A]: on Entry, read `utm_*` from the landing URL. A new landing with any `utm_*` replaces the whole set (last campaign wins). A landing without UTMs keeps a stored set. Other query params are ignored (`gclid` etc.).

**Carry**: two (three with `actionUrl`) cross-origin redirects, maybe into another browser (Q7).

| Where | Before consent | After consent |
|---|---|---|
| Memory (current page, client-side navigation) | yes | yes |
| `returnUrl` query, eID and payment (Q7) | yes: URL, not storage (Q5) | yes |
| `sessionStorage` (same tab, after a redirect) | no | yes |

Trust order as 04 invariant 2: stored > `returnUrl` query. On return, the app reads UTMs from the query only when nothing is stored. Without consent, UTMs exist only in the URL, so they survive the redirects but not a manual reload of a page without them.

`returnUrl` keeps the standard `utm_*` names. Side effect: the return page view re-states the campaign, so GA4 doesn't credit the eID or payment provider as a referral. Still needed from marketing: eID and payment domains in GA4 "unwanted referrals" (Q47).

Limits: UTMs add to `returnUrl` length, and the provider/API limit is not documented (02). UTMs reach the eID and payment providers in the URL; they hold no personal data.

## Consent

Assumption Q5: GTM Consent Mode v2, basic mode (no Google tags before consent). CMP vendor unknown.

| | Before a decision | Granted (`analytics_storage`) | Denied or withdrawn |
|---|---|---|---|
| Consent default | `gtag('consent', 'default', {analytics_storage, ad_storage, ad_user_data, ad_personalization: 'denied'})` before GTM loads | `update` by the CMP | stays denied |
| App events | Queued in memory, current page only | Queue flushed, then pushed live | Queue dropped, nothing pushed |
| UTMs | Memory + URL | + `sessionStorage` | Memory + URL. Withdrawal clears our keys |
| `purchase` guard | not written | `localStorage` | not written. Withdrawal keeps existing keys (orderId only, no personal data), so a re-grant + reload can't send `purchase` twice |
| GA cookies (`_ga`) | none | set by GA | none |

- Queued events not flushed before a redirect or reload are lost. Accepted (Q5): a user who decides after eID shows `identity_completed` without `plan_viewed`/`plan_selected`/`identity_started`, so the top of the funnel is undercounted.
- Return in another browser: no CMP cookie there, so the banner shows again on the callback page; events queue until the decision.
- The flow never waits for, or depends on, consent or GTM. Functional storage (open order, attempt marker, Q37) is not analytics and needs no consent.
- Advanced mode (cookieless pings) is a Legal decision (Q5).
- The CMP and GTM count against LCP, INP and CLS on Plans, not the JS size budget (08).

## Known gaps of client-side events

| Gap | Effect | Fix |
|---|---|---|
| User never returns from payment (closes tab, Unconfirmed → "Go to account", provider return fails) | `purchase` never sent, revenue undercounted | Server-side `purchase` (cut, PLAN.md) |
| Return in another tab or browser | Guard is per browser: a second browser can send `purchase` again. GA4 drops a repeated `transaction_id` only for the same user | Server-side `purchase` (cut) |
| Return in another browser | New GA client id: `purchase` attributed to a new user, campaign only from `returnUrl` UTMs | Server-side `purchase` (cut) |
| Consent denied | No events at all | Accepted (Legal) |
| Ad/tracking blockers | No events | Server-side `purchase` (cut) |
| `value` is an estimate | Can differ from what was charged | Amount on the order (Q4) |

# Senior Frontend Assignment: Spec-Driven Checkout Thank you for continuing with us. This assignment mirrors how we want to work: a product idea arrives half-finished, and you turn it into a spec that people and AI coding tools can build from safely. ## The scenario Nordlight is a fictional video streaming service in Estonia, Latvia and Lithuania. Product wants a new web flow where a visitor chooses a plan, identifies themselves with a national eID, pays, and lands in the app as a subscriber. The product brief, API notes, CMS content model and analytics notes are in `docs/`. They are realistic, which means they are incomplete and not fully consistent with each other. Engineering plans to build this feature mostly with AI coding tools. Your job is to write the spec that makes that possible, then prove it works. ## What to deliver 1. **The spec (about 60% of your effort).** Markdown files in the `spec/` folder. It must cover: - scope and non-goals; - the systems the frontend depends on and the systems that depend on it; - assumptions and open questions, each with who should answer; - the user flow as a state machine, including failure and recovery; - what you need from the API and the CMS; - analytics, i18n, accessibility and performance expectations; - a test strategy; - rollout and monitoring; - a breakdown into work items small enough for an AI tool to complete in one session, each with acceptance criteria. 2. **A thin slice (about 30%).** A working frontend of the flow from plan selection to confirmation against the mock server, in `app/`. Cover the happy path and at least two failure paths of your choice. Build it with AI tools, driven by your spec. Include unit tests and at least one end-to-end test. 3. **An AI working log** (`AI-LOG.md`). What you asked the tools to do, how you structured the context you gave them, and at least three specific places where the output was wrong or weak and what you did about it. A curated one to two pages is enough; raw transcripts are welcome as an appendix. 4. **A note to the team** (`TEAM-NOTE.md`, one page, about 10%). Written to the product lead and the backend lead: the five questions or risks that matter most, and your recommendation on each. ## Ground rules - **Time.** Plan on 4 to 5 hours and stop at 5. Tell us what you cut. A sharp spec with a small slice beats the reverse. - **AI use is expected.** Use any tools you like and tell us which. You are accountable for everything you submit, including what the tools wrote. - **Stack.** TypeScript with a component framework you know well (Vue or Nuxt, React or Next, or similar). No real provider integrations; use the mock server in `mock-server/`. - **Questions.** You may send up to three questions to your recruiter contact. We reply within one working day. Good questions count in your favour. - **Submission.** A git repository or zip with a README that explains how to run everything, the spec, the log and the note. ## What happens next We read your submission, then spend 60 minutes together walking through it. Expect us to ask why you made specific choices and what you would do differently with another week. # Plan Hard stop at 5:00. Clock started with discovery. Budget split follows the assignment: spec 60%, slice 30%, log + note 10%. | Phase | Budget | Ends at | |---|---|---| | 0. Discovery: read docs/mock, list inconsistencies, send 3 questions | 0:30 | 0:30 ✅ | | 1. Spec | 2:30 | 3:00 | | 2. Thin slice | 1:30 | 4:30 | | 3. AI-LOG, TEAM-NOTE, README | 0:30 | 5:00 | No buffer is left. If a phase overruns, take the time from the cut list below. Never take it from phase 3. ## Decisions (2026-11-10) - Stack: Next.js (App Router, `output: 'export'`), TypeScript, npm. - Tests: Vitest + Testing Library (unit), Playwright (E2E) against the mock with `MOCK_TIME_SCALE=50`. - Slice covers: happy path, `payment_declined`, `payment_slow` (polling), `identity_cancelled`/expired, `already_subscribed`, `payment_requires_action`. - Review step is built behind the `reviewStep` flag (on by default) (Q3). - All 6 market/locale pages are generated from CMS fixtures. LV is behind the `market.LV` flag (Q13). - Language switcher UI - Order body sends `market` (Q1). Prices come from the API only, and `priceLabel` is not rendered (Q2). - Out of the slice (spec only): analytics events + consent, UTM carry, email/receipt. - Open questions and working assumptions: `spec/03-open-questions.md`. ## Phase 1: Spec (2:30) | # | File | Covers | Budget | |---|---|---|---| | 1.1 | `spec/README.md` | Index, reading order for humans and AI tools | 5 | | 1.2 | `spec/01-scope.md` | Goals, scope, non-goals | 10 | | 1.3 | `spec/02-system-context.md` | Upstream (API, eID, payment, CMS, GTM, CDN) and downstream (GA4, account app, marketing) | 10 | | 1.4 | `spec/03-open-questions.md` | Keep current; add owners and answers as they arrive | 5 | | 1.5 | `spec/04-user-flow-state-machine.md` | State machine (mermaid): states, events, guards, failure and recovery, what survives a browser switch | 30 | | 1.6 | `spec/05-api-contract.md` | API contract as the frontend needs it (incl. `market`, error adapter, return params), field provenance, backend requests | 12 | | 1.7 | `spec/06-cms-contract.md` | CMS contract (required fields, planKey map, validation) | 8 | | 1.8 | `spec/07-analytics.md` | Analytics events, UTM carry, consent | 10 | | 1.9 | `spec/08-quality.md` | i18n + URLs, accessibility (WCAG 2.2 AA), performance budget | 10 | | 1.10 | `spec/09-testing.md` | Test pyramid, mock scenarios → test cases matrix | 15 | | 1.11 | `spec/10-rollout.md` | Flags, LV launch, monitoring, alerts, rollback | 10 | | 1.12 | `spec/11-work-items.md` | Work items sized for one AI session, each with acceptance criteria; slice items marked | 25 | | | | **Total** | **150** | Done when every topic in `ASSIGNMENT.md` § "The spec" maps to a file, and every work item has testable acceptance criteria. ## Phase 2: Thin slice (1:30) Each step is one work item from `spec/11-work-items.md`, done in one AI session. A flag change needs a rebuild | spec/02-system-context.md:87:| Account app | Product | Our redirect of active subscribers to `ACCOUNT_URL` (Q10) | Q10 | spec/02-system-context.md:141:| CORS | Allows `localhost` and `127.0.0.1` with credentials. More via `ALLOWED_ORIGINS` | Not configured yet: requirement on Backend | spec/05-api-contract.md:9:- Base URL from config: prod `https://api.nordlight.example` [D], local `http://localhost:4010`. The app runs on another origin (`www` [D]), so prod needs CORS with credentials (Q40). spec/05-api-contract.md:49:| Response | `orderId`, `paymentUrl` | 201, same | `orderId` [D], `paymentUrl` [D] | No amount, currency or trial flag (Q4) | spec/05-api-contract.md:96:4. **Amount, currency and trial flag on the order** (POST and GET), and what a trial order charges. | Nordlight API: `GET /v1/plans` | Backend | Fetched at build for first paint. Fetched again at runtime with credentials before Review (Q23) | Plan list per market, `priceNet`, `vatRate`, `currency` (Q2, Q26) | Runtime fetch before Review fails: error with retry, and the user can't continue to payment on a stale price |

| Nordlight API: `POST /v1/identity/sessions` | Backend | Credentialed fetch. Returns `redirectUrl` | Start eID | `429`: "try again in N s", using `Retry-After` (Q18) |
| Nordlight API: `POST /v1/orders`, `GET /v1/orders/{id}` | Backend | Credentialed fetch. Body includes `market` (Q1: the API notes list only `planId`, so this goes beyond the docs) and `returnUrl`. Status is polled (Q9) | Create the order, get `paymentUrl`, track status | `401`: restart from eID (Q17). `409 already_subscribed`: redirect to account (Q10). The button stays disabled while a request is in flight (Q19) |
| eID provider | External (contract through Backend) | Full-page redirect out to `redirectUrl`, back to `/auth/callback?status=ok\|cancelled\|expired` (Q6) | Identify the user. Sets `nl_session` (mechanism unknown, see note) | `cancelled` or `expired`: message and a "try again" button on the eID step. Returns without a session (other browser, Q7): "continue in this browser" plus restart. Provider down: the user is stuck on the provider's page and we can't detect it |
| Payment provider | External (contract through Backend) | Full-page redirect out to `paymentUrl` (or `actionUrl` for `requires_action`), back to `/payment/return?orderId=…[&cancelled=1]` (Q6) | Take payment, or capture a card for a trial (Q4) | `cancelled=1`: the user can try again, and each attempt creates a new order (Q19). Where the user lands is defined in `04-user-flow.md`. Decline: polling sees `failed`, message plus retry. Provider down: stuck on the provider's page and we can't detect it |

Never `priceLabel` (Q2) | An empty `legalText` fails the build (Q13). A CMS card with no matching API plan is hidden (Q8). An API plan with no CMS card is not covered by any source |
| Build config | Frontend + Platform | Env vars read at build | Flags `reviewStep` (on), `market.LV` (off). `API_BASE`, `ACCOUNT_URL` | A wrong value ships until the next deploy. A flag change needs a rebuild |

| Consent manager | Marketing + Legal | Unknown (Q5). Assumed GTM Consent Mode v2 | Gate for GA events and UTM persistence | Fails or blocked: no analytics, the flow keeps working |

### Note on Q6: who sets the session cookie?

The API notes say the eID provider sends the user back to `/auth/callback`. That route is on `www`, which is a static export with no server code. So the API never sees the eID result directly. The API can only set `nl_session` if one of these holds:

- the provider redirects to an API endpoint first, which sets the cookie and then redirects to `www/auth/callback`; or
- the provider calls the API server-to-server (like the payment webhook); or
- `/auth/callback` receives a code that the app sends to the API, and the API sets the cookie in its response.

The mock avoids the problem: its fake eID page runs on the API origin and sets the cookie itself. Working assumption: as in Q6, the mock behaviour is the contract, so after `?status=ok` the cookie is already there and the app only calls `GET /v1/me`. If Backend picks the code-exchange option, the callback needs one more API call. Q7's `state` parameter belongs in the same answer.

## Downstream: systems that depend on us

| System | Owner | What it depends on from us | Contract / reference |
|---|---|---|---|
| GA4 via GTM | Marketing | The exact event names (`plan_viewed` … `purchase`). `purchase` with `transaction_id`, `value`, `currency`, fired once per order. UTMs kept until `purchase` | GA. Q4 (value), Q5 (consent), Q20 (dedupe, params) |
| Nordlight API | Backend | `market` in the order body (Q1). `returnUrl` on our origin that carries flow context (Q7). No double submits (Q19) | API, Q1, Q7, Q19 |
| eID and payment providers (via the API's return-URL allowlist) | Backend | Stable callback paths `/auth/callback` and `/payment/return` on the production origin. The mock allowlist is `localhost`, `127.0.0.1` and `WEB_ORIGIN`. The production allowlist is not documented (Q6) | Mock, Q6 |
| Account app | Product | Our redirect of active subscribers to `ACCOUNT_URL` (Q10) | Q10 |
| Marketing's CMS publishing | Marketing | Our build turns a publish into a live page. Our build validation (Q13) can block a publish from going live | CMS, Q13 |

## Cross-origin requirements

Nothing in this section is documented for production. The mock only enables credentialed CORS for `localhost` and `127.0.0.1`. These are requirements for Backend and Platform.

### Same-site, cross-origin

- `www.nordlight.example` and `api.nordlight.example` are different **origins**, but the same **site** (`nordlight.example`). Because they share a site, `nl_session` counts as a first-party cookie. Safari ITP and third-party cookie blocking don't apply.
- **This design only works while the API stays under `nordlight.example`.** If the API moves to another registrable domain, the cookie becomes third-party and Safari and Firefox block it.

### CORS on every `/v1` response

# 10 · Rollout and monitoring

Config, flags, launch stages, alerts and rollback. States refer to `04-user-flow-state-machine.md`, events to `07-analytics.md`, Q-numbers to `03-open-questions.md`. Thresholds are proposals [A]; each owner confirms before stage 2.

## Principles

- **Revenue truth is the backend.** Paid orders come from `GET /v1/orders` data on the API side, never from GA `purchase`: it is consent-gated, blocked by ad blockers, missed when the user never returns, and can double-count across browsers (07 known gaps). GA is for the funnel shape only.
- **Rollback never strands a payment.** `/auth/callback`, `/payment/return`, Polling, Unconfirmed, IdentityLost and Confirmed ignore every flag and kill switch. An open order can always be resumed or checked.
- **Builds are compatible both ways.** A user can leave on build N and return on N−1. `returnUrl` params and storage keys change additively only, and stay readable for two releases.

## Config and flags

| Key | Default | Set at | Purpose |
|---|---|---|---|
| `API_BASE` | — | build | API origin (05) |
| `ACCOUNT_URL` | — | build | Redirect for active subscribers (Q10) |
| `market.LV` | off | build | Generates LV pages (06, 08). Off = LV paths → `/` |
| `reviewStep` | on | build (slice), runtime (prod) | Review between eID and Gate (Q3, Q32). Prod: experiment arm, see below |
| `reviewStep.offShare` | 0 % | runtime | Share of bucketed browsers in the off arm. 0 = no experiment, everyone on |
| `checkout.paused.{EE,LT,LV}` | false | runtime | Kill switch per market: no new eID start or order |
| `CONFIG_URL` | — | build | Runtime flag source (prod only, Q49) |

**Runtime flags** (static export, no server): JSON fetched from `CONFIG_URL` on Entry and again at the Gate, ≤ 60 s cache, 1.5 s timeout. Fetch fails → build defaults. Never blocks first paint.

**`checkout.paused`** applies only at StartingEid and Gate step 3: the retry point shows "temporarily unavailable", Pay and Select are disabled. Resume ("Continue payment", "Check status") stays available, so paused never strands an open order.

**Review experiment (prod)** [A]:
- Unit = browser. Random bucket id in `localStorage`, hashed to an arm. Written only after analytics consent (Q50); no consent → arm on, not in the readout.
- Arm is fixed per flow: carried in `returnUrl` (`rs`, Q7) and in the open order snapshot. Trust order as 04 invariant 2. A return in another browser keeps the flow's arm.
- Arm sent in `POST /v1/orders` body like `market` (Q51), so the readout joins backend paid orders by arm. 07 `review_step` = assigned arm, not the build value.
- Off arm starts only after Legal clears Q3/Q32: without Review, an anonymous user can't see trial vs full price before paying.

## Rollout stages

| # | Audience | Entry | Exit |
|---|---|---|---|
| 0 | Team, staging API + real provider sandboxes | Slice e2e green on mock (09). Q1, Q4, Q6, Q40 answered | Every 04 mock-scenario path reproduced on staging. Lighthouse and axe budgets pass (08) |
| 1 | Staff in prod, EE + LT, page not linked | Stage 0 exit. Alerts 1–8 wired and test-fired | ≥ 10 real paid orders per market. Backend paid = orders that reached Confirmed. Charged VAT and amount match the price shown (Q2, Q4). Refunds done |
| 2 | Public EE + LT, organic traffic only | Stage 1 exit. Owners confirmed thresholds | 7 days with no alert open > 1 h. No stranded order (pending > 24 h) |
| 3 | EE + LT, campaigns on | Stage 2 exit. Marketing: unwanted referrals set (Q47) | 14 days stable. Baseline conversion (backend paid / `plan_viewed`) recorded per market |
| 4 | Review experiment, EE + LT | Stage 3 exit. Legal sign-off (Q3, Q32). Sample size fixed in advance | Sample reached or 4 weeks. Decide on backend paid conversion; guardrails: refunds, complaints, PaymentFailed rate. Loser arm → `offShare` 0 or 100 |
| 5 | LV public, `reviewStep` on, not in experiment | ≥ 1 month after stage 2 start (Brief). LV launch gate passed | As stage 2, for LV |

## LV launch gate

| Check | Owner |
|---|---|
| Backend charges LV VAT (21 %) from `market` in the order body; LV plan ids only (Q1) | Backend |
| Premium decision: hidden (API has 2 plans) or added to the API (Q8) | Product |
| LV CMS entries complete: `legalText`, FAQ, LV.lv Standard bullets; build with `market.LV` on passes (06, Q13) | Marketing |
| `lv` catalog translated and approved (Q48) | Marketing + Product |
| LV eID and payment methods work on staging; LV return URLs in the provider allowlist (Q6) | Backend |
| Stage 1-style staff purchase in LV with `market.LV` on in a preview build | Frontend |
| Alerts 1–8 split by market include LV | Frontend + Backend |

## Alerts

| # | Signal | Threshold | Owner |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Backend: `paid / created` orders per market | < 70 % of 7-day same-hour baseline over 1 h | Backend |
| 2 | Backend: orders `pending` > 3 min (webhook lag, Q9) | > 5 % of orders in 15 min | Backend |
| 3 | API 5xx on `/v1/*` | > 2 % of requests for 5 min | Backend |
| 4 | `POST /v1/identity/sessions` 429 + 5xx | > 5 % of starts for 10 min | Backend |
| 5 | Backend: customers with ≥ 2 orders in 10 min (Q19, Q37) | > 1 % of ordering customers per day | Frontend + Backend |
| 6 | Client errors on flow routes (error tracker, Q49) | > 1 % of sessions for 15 min, or any new error after a deploy | Frontend |
| 7 | Synthetic GET of `/auth/callback`, `/payment/return`, each enabled pair | Non-200 twice in a row (5 min interval) | Platform |
| 8 | GA `purchase` / backend paid, per market per day | Ratio drops > 30 % vs 7-day mean (tracking broke, not sales) | Marketing |

## Rollback and kill switch

| Situation | Action | User mid-payment |
|---|---|---|
| Bad frontend deploy | CDN: restore previous build (atomic) | Callback paths and `returnUrl` params unchanged across builds; the return completes on the old build |
| Payment or eID provider down in a market (alerts 1–4) | `checkout.paused.{market}` on | New starts blocked. Open orders: Resume and Polling still work, Unconfirmed is the safe exit |
| Wrong price or VAT charged | `checkout.paused.{market}` on; Backend refunds | As above. Fix, then restage from stage 1 for that market |
| Review off arm hurts (guardrails) | `reviewStep.offShare` = 0 | Orders already past the Gate are unaffected. Next show re-derives: off-arm flows get Review |
| LV broken after launch | `checkout.paused.LV` on now; rebuild with `market.LV` off if content is the cause | Callbacks are market-agnostic and use stored context, so LV returns still reach Confirmed. A failed LV payment's retry point redirects to `/` |
| Bad CMS publish | Validation fails → previous build stays live (06). Passed but wrong → revert in CMS, rebuild | Not affected: callbacks don't read CMS copy |
| Duplicate orders (alert 5) | Frontend fix + redeploy; Backend refunds duplicates; push `Idempotency-Key` (Q19) | Not paused: the risk is a double charge, not a stuck user |
| Config fetch down | Nothing: build defaults apply (`reviewStep` on, not paused) | Not affected. Kill switches don't apply until the config is back: use a rebuild if urgent |

content.text:
I drafted `spec/10-rollout.md` (80 lines). Your three decisions mostly hold, but two needed changes:

**LV a month later behind a flag**: confirmed by the brief and Q13. One gap: `market.LV` is set at build time, so turning LV off fast needs a runtime switch. I added `checkout.paused.{EE,LT,LV}`.

**Review step as an experiment**: this one conflicts with what we already have.
- Q3 and Q32 say Review exists for legal consent. Without it, an anonymous user can't see trial vs full price before paying. So the off arm can only start after Legal signs off. It's gated in stage 4.
- Sticky assignment needs a bucket id in localStorage. That probably needs consent (Q50). Without consent the user gets Review on and is left out of the results.
- The arm has to travel in `returnUrl`, because the user may come back in another browser (Q7). It also has to go on the order body, so the backend can count paid orders per arm (Q51).
- Build-time in the slice: matches `02` and PLAN.

**Revenue truth from the backend**: consistent with the known gaps in `07`. Two limits:
- The order API returns no amount (Q4), so checking what was actually charged waits on Q4.
- Alert 8 compares GA `purchase` with backend paid orders, to catch broken tracking.

**Other additions:**
- Rollback rule: callbacks, Polling and Confirmed ignore every flag, so a rollback can't strand a payment. "Continue payment" stays available even when a market is paused.
- `returnUrl` and storage changes stay additive for two releases, so a user who leaves on the new build and returns on the old one still completes.
- Alert thresholds are my own numbers, marked [A]. Owners confirm them before stage 2.

**Added to `03`:**
- **Q49:** runtime flag source and error tracker. No vendor is named, and the tracker is a new dependency.
- **Q50:** Legal on the bucket-id consent and the off arm.
- **Q51:** backend stores the arm on the order.

**Now stale, not edited:**
- `02-system-context.md` still says "a flag change needs a rebuild".
- `07` describes `review_step` as the build value; in prod it should be the assigned arm.

Your memory note says you draft specs yourself and I review. I wrote this one because you asked.

content.text:
Here are the findings. I made no edits.

## Alerts whose signal the app doesn't emit

- **Alert 6 (client errors)**: nothing emits it. 04, 07 and 08 define no error tracker. 07 bans error messages in GA and cut the error events, and Q49 is still open. If nobody adds a tracker, this alert has no data.
- **Alert 3 (API 5xx)**: only sees errors that reach the server. Network, CORS (Q40) and timeout failures that 04 routes to StartError, VerifyError or "Connection issue" are invisible. The app emits nothing for those.
- **Alert 7 (synthetic)**: a static callback page always returns 200 from the CDN. The check proves the HTML exists, not that the return works. It's a probe signal; the app adds nothing to it.
- **Alert 8**: `purchase` exists, but analytics is out of the slice (PLAN), so it's only valid in prod. Its baseline moves with the consent rate.
- **Alerts 1, 2, 4, 5**: backend signals, which is fine. But 05's backend requests don't ask for these metrics or dashboards, so there is no owner commitment.
- **Signals used outside the alerts table**:
  - Stage 1 exit, "orders that reached Confirmed": the only app signal is GA `purchase`, which is consent-gated.
  - Stage 3 baseline, `plan_viewed`: consent-gated and undercounted (07), compared against backend paid orders. Two different sources in one ratio.
  - Stage 4 guardrails: no event exists for PaymentFailed (07 cut it), and there's no complaints signal at all.
  - Experiment arm: 07 still sends `review_step` as the build value, so the arm isn't emitted.

## Launch blockers from 03 missing from every stage's entry

- **Q5**: consent manager / Consent Mode (P0, Legal). It's also needed before stage 4 bucketing (Q50).
- **Q7**: `state` param, login CSRF (P0, Security).
- **Q10**: no `ACCOUNT_URL` target. The existing-subscriber redirect has nowhere to go.
- **Q15**: no receipt or recovery contact, which 03 calls a launch risk.
- **Q16**: no logout or "not you?", also flagged in 03.
- **Q48**: `et`, `lt` and `en` catalogs must be translated before launch. Only the `lv` catalog is gated (LV gate).
- **Q2**: only a stage 1 exit check. Marketing's sign-off that `priceLabel` is not used is not an entry criterion.
- **Q3**: only gates stage 4. Its status is still `sent`, but Review is on by default, so it's acceptable.
- **Minor**: GA custom dimension registration (07) is not in stage 3 entry.

## A user on the payment page during each rollback

The provider page itself is never affected. Each case below is about what happens when the user comes back.

1. **Bad deploy, restore**: OK if the "additive for two releases" rule holds. Nothing enforces it: there's no test in 09. A user who returned during the bad window keeps the open order and is resumed at the Gate.
2. **`checkout.paused`, provider down**: this one **strands users**.
   - Pause blocks StartingEid. The only exit from IdentityLost ("Verify") and from OtherBrowser ("Start again here") goes through StartingEid.
   - So a user whose session expired, or who returns in another browser, can't see their order status. This contradicts the principle that "IdentityLost ignores every kill switch".
   - Also, "Continue payment" during pause sends the user back to a provider that is down.
3. **Wrong price**: the pause doesn't stop a payment already in flight, so the user pays the wrong amount. Only "Backend refunds" covers it, with no message to the user. Also has the IdentityLost gap from item 2.
4. **`offShare` = 0**: the doc contradicts itself. "Arm is fixed per flow" (stored or `rs` wins) versus "next show re-derives: off-arm flows get Review". There's no forced-override rule.
   - The retry point after a failed payment is undefined: Plans in the off arm (Q38), Review in the on arm.
5. **LV pause or rebuild**:
   - Pause: the IdentityLost and OtherBrowser gap again.
   - Rebuild with `market.LV` off:
     - Callbacks check locale with `resolvePair`, which now rejects LV. They fall back to `/ee/et/`, so an LV user returning from payment sees Estonian.
     - A failed payment redirects to `/`, then into EE pages. Stored context still says LV but the URL says EE, so the user risks an order in the wrong market or with the wrong VAT.
6. **Bad CMS publish**: the claim "callbacks don't read CMS copy" is wrong. Confirmed shows the plan title, which comes from CMS `title` (06). A bad publish that passes validation shows wrong copy on return until it's reverted.
7. **Duplicate orders**: same as item 1. The user is not paused, so a double charge is still possible until the fix ships.
8. **Config fetch down**: the Gate falls back to defaults, so an off-arm user flips to on mid-flow. Whether that's allowed depends on the unresolved item 4 contradiction. Kill switches are silently off, and the only fallback is a rebuild, which takes minutes.

1. **`market` on `POST /v1/orders`**, or derive it server-side, and reject a plan not sold in that market. Otherwise wrong VAT is charged (Q1).

# 10 · Rollout and monitoring

Config, flags, launch stages, alerts and rollback. States refer to `04-user-flow-state-machine.md`, events to `07-analytics.md`, Q-numbers to `03-open-questions.md`. Thresholds are proposals [A]; each owner confirms before stage 2.

## Principles

- **Revenue truth is the backend.** Paid orders come from backend order data (05 request 16), never from GA `purchase`: it is consent-gated, blocked by ad blockers, missed when the user never returns, and can double-count across browsers (07 known gaps). GA is for the funnel shape only.
- **Rollback never strands a payment.** `/auth/callback`, `/payment/return`, Polling, Unconfirmed, IdentityLost, OtherBrowser and Confirmed ignore every flag and kill switch, and so does a re-verify eID start (orderId in context, 07 `eid_purpose: reverify`). "Check status" on an open order always works.
- **Builds are compatible both ways.** A user can leave on build N and return on N−1. `returnUrl` params and storage keys change additively only, and stay readable for two releases. Check: e2e returns with the previous release's `returnUrl` and storage fixtures.

## Config and flags

| Key | Default | Set at | Purpose |
|---|---|---|---|
| `API_BASE` | — | build | API origin (05) |
| `ACCOUNT_URL` | — | build | Redirect for active subscribers (Q10) |
| `market.LV` | off | build | Generates LV pages (06, 08). Off = LV paths → `/`; see *Disabled market* |
| `reviewStep` | on | build (slice), runtime (prod) | Review between eID and Gate (Q3, Q32). Prod: experiment arm, see below |
| `reviewStep.offShare` | 0 % | runtime | Share of bucketed browsers in the off arm. 0 = no experiment, everyone on |
| `checkout.paused.{EE,LT,LV}` | false | build default, runtime override | Kill switch per market: no new money movement |
| `CONFIG_URL` | — | build | Runtime flag source (prod only, Q49) |

**Runtime flags** (static export, no server): JSON fetched from `CONFIG_URL` on Entry and again at the Gate, ≤ 60 s cache, 1.5 s timeout. Fetch fails → build defaults. Never blocks first paint.

**`checkout.paused`**: applies at StartingEid (checkout purpose only) and the Gate. The retry point shows "temporarily unavailable"; Select, Pay and Try again are disabled. Resume shows only "Check status", not "Continue payment", so no one pays while paused (wrong price, provider down).

**Review experiment (prod)** [A]:
- Unit = browser. Random bucket id in `localStorage`, hashed to an arm. Written only after analytics consent (Q50); no consent → arm on, not in the readout.
- Arm is carried in `returnUrl` (`rs`, Q7) and the open order snapshot, trust order as 04 invariant 2, so a return in another browser keeps it.
- Override: `offShare` 0 or config down → arm on at the next state show, even mid-flow (Review only adds a step). Orders past the Gate are unaffected. Overridden flows are excluded from the readout.
- Arm sent in `POST /v1/orders` like `market` (Q51), so backend paid orders join by arm. 07 `review_step` = this arm.
- Off arm starts only after Legal clears Q3/Q32: without Review, an anonymous user can't see trial vs full price before paying.

**Disabled market** (LV rolled back after launch, Q52): callbacks resolve locale against all known pairs, not only enabled ones, so LV users read `lv`. Where 04 would land on a retry point or Plans, they see "not available right now" with the order status. No Try again, no Change plan, no redirect into another market.

## Rollout stages

| # | Audience | Entry | Exit |
|---|---|---|---|
| 0 | Team, staging API + real provider sandboxes | Slice e2e green on mock (09). Answered: Q1, Q4, Q6, Q7 (or Security accepts), Q40 | Every 04 mock-scenario path reproduced on staging. Lighthouse and axe budgets pass (08) |
| 1 | Staff in prod, EE + LT, page not linked | Stage 0 exit. Q5 CMP live. Q10 `ACCOUNT_URL` set. Q49 config + error tracker live. Q51 metrics live. Alerts 1–8 test-fired | ≥ 10 real paid orders per market, each order id logged by staff with the screen they reached; Backend confirms all `paid`. Charged VAT and amount match the price shown (Q2, Q4). Refunds done |
| 2 | Public EE + LT, organic traffic only | Stage 1 exit. Owners confirmed thresholds. `et`, `lt`, `en` catalogs approved (Q48). Marketing confirms `priceLabel` unused (Q2). Product accepts Q15, Q16 | 7 days with no alert open > 1 h. No stranded order (pending > 24 h) |
| 3 | EE + LT, campaigns on | Stage 2 exit. Unwanted referrals set (Q47). GA4 custom dimensions registered (07) | 14 days stable. Baseline per market: backend paid / GA `plan_viewed`. Undercounted by consent and blockers, so only compared with itself over time |
| 4 | Review experiment, EE + LT | Stage 3 exit. Legal sign-off (Q3, Q32, Q50). Sample size fixed in advance | Sample reached or 4 weeks. Primary: backend paid / `plan_viewed` per arm (both arms consented, so comparable). Guardrails per arm from backend: `failed` / created, refunds. Loser → `offShare` 0 or 100 |
| 5 | LV public, `reviewStep` on, not in experiment | ≥ 1 month after stage 2 start (Brief). LV launch gate passed | As stage 2, for LV |

## LV launch gate

| Check | Owner |
|---|---|
| Backend charges LV VAT (21 %) from `market` in the order body; LV plan ids only (Q1) | Backend |
| Premium decision: hidden (API has 2 plans) or added to the API (Q8) | Product |
| LV CMS entries complete: `legalText`, FAQ, LV.lv Standard bullets; build with `market.LV` on passes (06, Q13) | Marketing |
| `lv` catalog translated and approved, incl. the disabled-market notice (Q48, Q52) | Marketing + Product |
| LV eID and payment methods work on staging; LV return URLs in the provider allowlist (Q6) | Backend |
| Stage 1-style staff purchase in LV with `market.LV` on in a preview build | Frontend |
| Alerts 1–8 split by market include LV | Frontend + Backend |

## Alerts

| # | Signal | Threshold | Owner |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Backend: `paid / created` orders per market (05 req. 16) | < 70 % of 7-day same-hour baseline over 1 h | Backend |
| 2 | Backend: orders `pending` > 3 min (webhook lag, Q9) | > 5 % of orders in 15 min | Backend |
| 3 | API server: 5xx on `/v1/*`. Network, CORS and timeouts are in alert 6 | > 2 % of requests for 5 min | Backend |
| 4 | Backend: `POST /v1/identity/sessions` 429 + 5xx | > 5 % of starts for 10 min | Backend |
| 5 | Backend: customers with ≥ 2 orders in 10 min (Q19, Q37) | > 1 % of ordering customers per day | Frontend + Backend |
| 6 | Error tracker (Q49): uncaught errors, plus error-adapter kinds network, timeout and 5xx by endpoint. No personal data (07 list) | > 1 % of sessions for 15 min, or any new error after a deploy | Frontend |
| 7 | Synthetic, no session: `/payment/return?orderId=synthetic` renders IdentityLost; `/auth/callback?status=expired` renders EidFailed; each enabled pair renders its `headline` | Fails twice in a row (5 min interval) | Platform |
| 8 | Prod only: GA `purchase` / backend paid, per market per day | Ratio drops > 30 % vs 7-day mean (tracking broke, not sales) | Marketing |

## Rollback and kill switch

The provider page is outside our control; each row is what the user meets on return.

| Situation | Action | User returning from payment |
|---|---|---|
| Bad frontend deploy | CDN: restore previous build (atomic) | Lands on the old build; compatible params and storage (principles). Returned during the bad window → open order resumed at the next Gate |
| Payment or eID provider down (alerts 1–4) | `checkout.paused.{market}` on | Return, polling and re-verify work. Pending order: "Check status" only; Unconfirmed is the safe exit |
| Wrong price or VAT charged | `checkout.paused.{market}` on; Backend refunds the difference to the card (no email, Q15) | Payments already on the provider page complete at the wrong price; refunded. Fix, then restage that market from stage 1 |
| Review off arm hurts (guardrails) | `reviewStep.offShare` = 0 | Orders past the Gate unaffected. A failed payment lands on Review (arm overridden to on) |
| LV broken after launch | `checkout.paused.LV` on. Content or legal cause → rebuild with `market.LV` off | Callbacks still reach Confirmed in `lv`. Failures show the disabled-market notice, never EE pages |
| Bad CMS publish | Validation fails → previous build stays live (06). Passed but wrong → revert in CMS, rebuild | Confirmed shows the CMS plan title: wrong until the rebuild |
| Duplicate orders (alert 5) | Fix + redeploy (row 1); Backend refunds duplicates; push `Idempotency-Key` (Q19) | Not paused: the risk is a double charge until the fix ships |
| Config fetch down | Build defaults apply: arm on, not paused | Not affected. Kill switches off until config is back; urgent → rebuild with `checkout.paused` default on |

# 10 · Rollout and monitoring

Config, flags, launch stages, alerts and rollback. States refer to `04-user-flow-state-machine.md`, events to `07-analytics.md`, Q-numbers to `03-open-questions.md`. Thresholds are proposals [A]; each owner confirms before stage 2.

## Principles

- **Revenue truth is the backend.** Paid orders come from backend order data (05 request 16), never from GA `purchase`: it is consent-gated, blocked by ad blockers, missed when the user never returns, and can double-count across browsers (07 known gaps). GA is for the funnel shape only.
- **Rollback never strands a payment.** `/auth/callback`, `/payment/return`, Polling, Unconfirmed, IdentityLost, OtherBrowser and Confirmed ignore every flag and kill switch, and so does a re-verify eID start (orderId in context, 07 `eid_purpose: reverify`). "Check status" on an open order always works.
- **Builds are compatible both ways.** A user can leave on build N and return on N−1. `returnUrl` params and storage keys change additively only, and stay readable for two releases. Check: e2e returns with the previous release's `returnUrl` and storage fixtures.

## Config and flags

| Key | Default | Set at | Purpose |
|---|---|---|---|
| `API_BASE` | — | build | API origin (05) |
| `ACCOUNT_URL` | — | build | Redirect for active subscribers (Q10) |
| `market.LV` | off | build | Generates LV pages (06, 08). Off = LV paths → `/`; see *Disabled market* |
| `reviewStep` | on | build (slice), runtime (prod) | Review between eID and Gate (Q3, Q32). Prod: experiment arm, see below |
| `reviewStep.offShare` | 0 % | runtime | Share of bucketed browsers in the off arm. 0 = no experiment, everyone on |
| `checkout.paused.{EE,LT,LV}` | false | build default, runtime override | Kill switch per market: no new money movement |
| `CONFIG_URL` | — | build | Runtime flag source (prod only, Q49) |

**Runtime flags** (static export, no server): JSON fetched from `CONFIG_URL` on Entry and again at the Gate, ≤ 60 s cache, 1.5 s timeout. Fetch fails → build defaults. Never blocks first paint.

**`checkout.paused`**: applies at StartingEid (checkout purpose only) and the Gate. The retry point shows "temporarily unavailable"; Select, Pay and Try again are disabled. Resume shows only "Check status", not "Continue payment", so no one pays while paused (wrong price, provider down).

**Review experiment (prod)** [A]:
- Unit = browser. Random bucket id in `localStorage`, hashed to an arm. Written only after analytics consent (Q50); no consent → arm on, not in the readout.
- Arm is carried in `returnUrl` (`rs`, Q7) and the open order snapshot, trust order as 04 invariant 2, so a return in another browser keeps it.
- Override: `offShare` 0 or config down → arm on at the next state show, even mid-flow (Review only adds a step). Orders past the Gate are unaffected. Overridden flows are excluded from the readout.
- Arm sent in `POST /v1/orders` like `market` (Q51), so backend paid orders join by arm. 07 `review_step` = this arm.
- Off arm starts only after Legal clears Q3/Q32: without Review, an anonymous user can't see trial vs full price before paying.

**Disabled market** (LV rolled back after launch, Q52): callbacks resolve locale against all known pairs, not only enabled ones, so LV users read `lv`. Where 04 would land on a retry point or Plans, they see "not available right now" with the order status. No Try again, no Change plan, no redirect into another market.

## Rollout stages

| # | Audience | Entry | Exit |
|---|---|---|---|
| 0 | Team, staging API + real provider sandboxes | Slice e2e green on mock (09). Answered: Q1, Q4, Q6, Q7 (or Security accepts), Q40 | Every 04 mock-scenario path reproduced on staging. Lighthouse and axe budgets pass (08) |
| 1 | Staff in prod, EE + LT, page not linked | Stage 0 exit. Q5 CMP live. Q10 `ACCOUNT_URL` set. Q49 config + error tracker live. Q51 metrics live. Alerts 1–8 test-fired | ≥ 10 real paid orders per market, each order id logged by staff with the screen they reached; Backend confirms all `paid`. Charged VAT and amount match the price shown (Q2, Q4). Refunds done |
| 2 | Public EE + LT, organic traffic only | Stage 1 exit. Owners confirmed thresholds. `et`, `lt`, `en` catalogs approved (Q48). Marketing confirms `priceLabel` unused (Q2). Product accepts Q15, Q16 | 7 days with no alert open > 1 h. No stranded order (pending > 24 h) |
| 3 | EE + LT, campaigns on | Stage 2 exit. Unwanted referrals set (Q47). GA4 custom dimensions registered (07) | 14 days stable. Baseline per market: backend paid / GA `plan_viewed`. Undercounted by consent and blockers, so only compared with itself over time |
| 4 | Review experiment, EE + LT | Stage 3 exit. Legal sign-off (Q3, Q32, Q50). Sample size fixed in advance | Sample reached or 4 weeks. Primary: backend paid / `plan_viewed` per arm (both arms consented, so comparable). Guardrails per arm from backend: `failed` / created, refunds. Loser → `offShare` 0 or 100 |
| 5 | LV public, `reviewStep` on, not in experiment | ≥ 1 month after stage 2 start (Brief). LV launch gate passed | As stage 2, for LV |

## LV launch gate

| Check | Owner |
|---|---|
| Backend charges LV VAT (21 %) from `market` in the order body; LV plan ids only (Q1) | Backend |
| Premium decision: hidden (API has 2 plans) or added to the API (Q8) | Product |
| LV CMS entries complete: `legalText`, FAQ, LV.lv Standard bullets; build with `market.LV` on passes (06, Q13) | Marketing |
| `lv` catalog translated and approved, incl. the disabled-market notice (Q48, Q52) | Marketing + Product |
| LV eID and payment methods work on staging; LV return URLs in the provider allowlist (Q6) | Backend |
| Stage 1-style staff purchase in LV with `market.LV` on in a preview build | Frontend |
| Alerts 1–8 split by market include LV | Frontend + Backend |

## Alerts

| # | Signal | Threshold | Owner |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Backend: `paid / created` orders per market (05 req. 16) | < 70 % of 7-day same-hour baseline over 1 h | Backend |
| 2 | Backend: orders `pending` > 3 min (webhook lag, Q9) | > 5 % of orders in 15 min | Backend |
| 3 | API server: 5xx on `/v1/*`. Network, CORS and timeouts are in alert 6 | > 2 % of requests for 5 min | Backend |
| 4 | Backend: `POST /v1/identity/sessions` 429 + 5xx | > 5 % of starts for 10 min | Backend |
| 5 | Backend: customers with ≥ 2 orders in 10 min (Q19, Q37) | > 1 % of ordering customers per day | Frontend + Backend |
| 6 | Error tracker (Q49): uncaught errors, plus error-adapter kinds network, timeout and 5xx by endpoint. No personal data (07 list) | > 1 % of sessions for 15 min, or any new error after a deploy | Frontend |
| 7 | Synthetic, no session: `/payment/return?orderId=synthetic` renders IdentityLost; `/auth/callback?status=expired` renders EidFailed; each enabled pair renders its `headline` | Fails twice in a row (5 min interval) | Platform |
| 8 | Prod only: GA `purchase` / backend paid, per market per day | Ratio drops > 30 % vs 7-day mean (tracking broke, not sales) | Marketing |

## Rollback and kill switch

The provider page is outside our control; each row is what the user meets on return.

| Situation | Action | User returning from payment |
|---|---|---|
| Bad frontend deploy | CDN: restore previous build (atomic) | Lands on the old build; compatible params and storage (principles). Returned during the bad window → open order resumed at the next Gate |
| Payment or eID provider down (alerts 1–4) | `checkout.paused.{market}` on | Return, polling and re-verify work. Pending order: "Check status" only; Unconfirmed is the safe exit |
| Wrong price or VAT charged | `checkout.paused.{market}` on; Backend refunds the difference to the card (no email, Q15) | Payments already on the provider page complete at the wrong price; refunded. Fix, then restage that market from stage 1 |
| Review off arm hurts (guardrails) | `reviewStep.offShare` = 0 | Orders past the Gate unaffected. A failed payment lands on Review (arm overridden to on) |
| LV broken after launch | `checkout.paused.LV` on. Content or legal cause → rebuild with `market.LV` off | Callbacks still reach Confirmed in `lv`. Failures show the disabled-market notice, never EE pages |
| Bad CMS publish | Validation fails → previous build stays live (06). Passed but wrong → revert in CMS, rebuild | Confirmed shows the CMS plan title: wrong until the rebuild |
| Duplicate orders (alert 5) | Fix + redeploy (row 1); Backend refunds duplicates; push `Idempotency-Key` (Q19) | Not paused: the risk is a double charge until the fix ships |
| Config fetch down | Build defaults apply: arm on, not paused | Not affected. Kill switches off until config is back; urgent → rebuild with `checkout.paused` default on |
